title: Bear Flags Forming On Metals: The Levels To Buy
speaker: Verified Investing analyst (name garbled as "Lton")

macro_themes.view: Gold, silver and platinum are forming bear flags/H&S breakdowns, with defined levels to buy the bounce.

calls.condition: Expects a bounce at the lower wedge trend line ~4,000; if gold falls below 4,000 he might be a buyer near 3,500.
calls.reason: Bear flag forming after rejection at the top of the wedge; 4,000 is the lower trend line, a pivot cluster and a key psychological level.
calls.quote: So the reason why I believe this looks bearish is because you have basically a bare flag beginning to form.

calls.condition: If the bear flag resolves lower, look for a bounce at the measured move / pivots ~55-56.
calls.reason: Broke a head and shoulders; bear flag forming with measured move near $55.
calls.quote: I love these pivots all around this $5556 level for a potential bounce here on silver.

calls.condition: If it keeps falling, expect support and a bounce at the 83.34 gap fill.
calls.reason: Broke out of a down-sloping channel and inverse H&S; now retesting; 83.34 is a long-standing consolidation level.
calls.quote: So for me, X marks the spot. If we can come into that area, I'd anticipate potentially a bounce

calls.condition: $3 is the line in the sand; a renewed breakout meets resistance at the prior pivot high then ~3.34-3.35.
calls.reason: Inverse H&S breakout retraced to the neckline at ~$3.
calls.quote: This is the line in the sand, right?

calls.condition: Head-and-shoulders measured move to ~1538, where he expects support and a bounce.
calls.reason: Bear flag plus a clear head-and-shoulders breakdown with measured move aligning with a pivot low.
calls.quote: that measured move would take us nicely down to basically look at this how all these levels are aligning this pivot low around uh 1538.

notes: No date or weekday stated, so listing date used. Speaker name garbled ("Lton"). Silver levels spoken as "$5556" and read as 55-56. Nat gas resistance spoken as "33435" and read as 3.34-3.35. No current prices were quoted.
